parameters.content:
Automatic assurance assessment (no provider calls)

Two entry points, one job: drain public.assurance_assessment_jobs.

1. Database Webhook (recommended): create a Supabase Database Webhook on public.assurance_assessment_jobs INSERT and point it at this workflow's webhook path. The queue row is written inside the final publication transaction of rpc/complete_document_job, so import a document, publish it, and the assessment runs without anyone opening the dashboard.
2. Schedule (required safety net): runs every 5 minutes, so a missed webhook, an expired lease, or a retry that was waiting on backoff is picked up automatically.

This workflow calls rpc/claim_next_assurance_assessment_job through the app route, which only ever consumes published observations, coverage, provenance, and source versions. It never calls a model, never queues extraction, and never retries an extraction group.

Required n8n environment variables

XASS_APP_URL                 base URL of the Next.js app (no trailing slash)
XASS_ASSESSMENT_SECRET       shared secret for /api/internal/assurance/assessment
XASS_ASSESSMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET  optional; when set, the webhook entry point rejects requests without it

The service-role key stays in the app and, for document processing, in its own workflow. Never send it to this webhook.
